scope: Follow-up to P6 online-friend delivery: commit-time eligibility guard for the P11 online-sharing preference.
implementation: The existing production notification repository provides an additive guarded capability. Current accepted friendship, bilateral blocks, active nonbot accounts, actor visible status and sharing consent, and recipient opt-in are checked in the insertion transaction. Recipient offline status does not prevent inbox delivery.

PostgreSQL takes ordered account-row guards and NOWAIT shared authorization-table guards to serialize with relevant account, relationship and preference writers. Conflicts roll back without a notice. Service broadcasts and marks the in-process epoch only for returned committed rows; missing guarded capability fails closed.

The guarantee is authorization at the serialized commit snapshot, not erasure of a notice after a later revocation. Existing process-local reconnect deduplication is not durable exactly-once delivery.
